findings.description: William Mc Allister (McFerran) and Mary Jane Magee had a son, Thomas John McFerran, born 4 June 1879 at Downpatrick, County Down, Ireland.
supporting_sources: Ireland, Civil Registration, 1845-1913 — birth entry for Thomas John McFerran, 4 Jun 1879, parents William McFerran and Mary Jane Magee McFeran
